mapper.update: UPDATE arte_ai_search_generation SET last_success_at=#{now} WHERE generation=#{g}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM arte_ai_search_checkpoint WHERE generation=#{g} AND lane=#{lane}
mapper.update: UPDATE arte_ai_search_checkpoint SET cursor_key=#{cursor},rounds=#{rounds},next_at=#{next} WHERE generation=#{g} AND lane=#{lane}
UPDATE arte_ai_search_work SET pending=TRUE,force_write=(force_write OR #{force}) WHERE generation=#{g} AND task_key=#{task}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM arte_ai_search_work WHERE generation=#{g} AND task_key > #{after} ORDER BY task_key LIMIT #{size}
SELECT * FROM arte_ai_search_work WHERE generation=#{g} AND pending=TRUE AND next_at <= #{now} ORDER BY next_at,task_key LIMIT #{size}
mapper.update: UPDATE arte_ai_search_work SET pending=TRUE,failures=failures+1,error_code=#{code},next_at=#{next} WHERE generation=#{g} AND task_key=#{task}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM arte_ai_search_entry WHERE generation=#{g} AND task_key=#{task} ORDER BY entry_key
SELECT * FROM arte_ai_search_entry WHERE generation=#{g} AND entry_key=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE arte_ai_search_entry SET acknowledged=#{rev} WHERE generation=#{g} AND entry_key=#{id} AND revision=#{rev}
UPDATE arte_ai_search_generation SET validation_epoch=#{epoch} WHERE generation=#{g}
UPDATE arte_ai_search_work SET pending=TRUE,failures=0,error_code=NULL,next_at=#{next} WHERE generation=#{g} AND task_key=#{task}
